I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree. Updated: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. I'll go with Gate 47 from now on."

The new site for the lane is Gate 47; Dock 23 was wrong. My earlier thread reply with Dock 23 is still posted in the channel and I haven't edited it, but the correction is now right next to it.
